name: Aegis · Insurance & Cover
mission: Insurance and cover: every policy with its premium, deductible, limits and renewal; claims from filed to paid; the warranties Hearth and Records hold; and checks of the cover against the other pillars (the house's contents against the personal-property limit, the largest deductible against Midas's cash floor).
signature: The shield: each policy a band across it, lit toward its renewal, and the house's contents against the cover beneath.
